about_the_game:
"My House Topia" is a relaxing sticker-based game that lets you create your dream home in a world of endless possibilities! Decorate everything from cozy rooms to luxurious villas, bustling cities to vast galaxies, all with fun and easy-to-use stickers. Choose from different gameplay modes: complete collages based on reference blueprints, unleash your creativity in free mode, or play the endless mode with limitless furniture options.

What’s more, you can explore and download creative mods made by other players in the community, adding endless variety to your design experience. There are no time limits or stamina restrictions, so you can play at your own pace and let your imagination run wild. Whether you’re building your dream home, designing a new city, or creating the perfect space, "My House Topia" offers a fun, therapeutic escape where you’re in complete control.

Design, decorate, and build—whenever and wherever you want!
